A1.justification: Both PDFs describe TAMO, with readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–G. Renumbered and relocated material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: V1 reports original optimization experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks, including generalization tests and appendix ablations.

after.justification: V2 retains original benchmark experiments and appendix analyses, with revised empirical curves.

M1.justification: The stated REINFORCE update in Equation 4 changes from weighting actions by their immediate discounted reward to a discounted reward-to-go, revising training credit assignment as written. The architecture, prediction objective, and inference procedure remain unchanged; an implementation change is not established.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic GP and analytic tasks, Oil Sorbent, LaserPlasma, and four HPO-3DGS scenes. Single-objective, dimensional-transfer, and decoupled-feedback coverage is retained.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain BOFormer, qNEHVI, qNParEGO, qHVKG, random search, and the single-objective qEI baseline where applicable. Figure 4b changes the erroneous MAPLE labels to TAMO, rather than introducing a different comparator.

E3.justification: Table S1 changes the reported training discount factor from 1.0 to 0.99. Other documented training budgets, model sizes, candidate-set sizes, normalization, and evaluation budgets are retained. This establishes a reported setting revision, not that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: V1's Figure S9, separating GP surrogate-refitting and acquisition-optimization costs, is removed. The remaining ablation questions are retained, with revised evidence particularly for discount-factor sensitivity and pretraining-prior composition.

E5.justification: Removing the timing breakdown also removes its report of means plus or minus one standard deviation over 10 runs. Retained experiments continue reporting 95% confidence intervals over the same stated 30, 50, or 60 runs.

E6.justification: Numerous main and appendix performance trajectories change. Figure S6 replaces substantial early-convergence differences across discount factors with nearly overlapping curves. The shorter-lengthscale prior changes from benefiting Ackley–Rastrigin in v1 Figure S11 to hurting it in v2 Figure S10. These substantively revise reported results; the training revisions prevent treating them as established same-setting gains.

T1.justification: Equation 4 replaces gamma^(t-1)r_t with R_t and introduces R_t = sum from k=t to T of gamma^(k-t)r_k. This substantively revises the mathematical gradient estimator. The trajectory objective, other formal definitions, and appendix algorithms are retained.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and discussion retain the same central claims: fully amortized, dimension-agnostic optimization, competitive Pareto quality, and 50–1000-fold faster proposals. Revised supporting results do not redefine those claims.

C2.justification: Figure S6 drops the interpretation linking greater non-myopicity to faster early progress. Section 6 adds a specific proposed acceleration mechanism: autoregressive causal buffers could avoid repeated context encoding. The principal limitations concerning pretraining composition and discrete candidate pools remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 5 and the reproducibility statement change code access from a promised release upon acceptance to reported GitHub availability. Hardware and implementation documentation are otherwise largely retained, alongside the revised discount-factor value.

R1.justification: V2 adds Blumer et al. (2026) on in-context optimization with unreliable feedback and Hassan et al. (2026) on efficient autoregressive transformer inference. These modestly extend related work and future directions without changing the central novelty positioning.

P1.justification: V2 makes targeted wording edits, adds an Ethics Statement, rearranges the reproducibility statement and acknowledgments, and updates publication and author-block text. The main section sequence and explanatory narrative remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: V2 adopts ICLR formatting and reflows figures and Table S1. It removes the timing plot, consolidates Figure S7's legends, adjusts plot axes and captions, and corrects Figure 4b's labels. Architecture diagrams and GP visualizations are retained, with later appendix figures renumbered.

improvement.justification: The explicit reward-to-go formulation and corrected TAMO legend improve technical clarity, while Figure S6's narrower commentary better matches its revised curves. Reported code availability improves reproducibility information. Removing the timing decomposition sacrifices useful diagnostic evidence, but the main timing comparisons remain, making the net improvement limited.
